title: Map labelling #6
topic: museum · holiday village · sports centre · university campus
context:
Narrator: Map 1. The museum.
Guide: Welcome to the museum. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the cafeteria is the first building on your left.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the temporary exhibition. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the cloakroom is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: The maritime gallery is directly behind the cloakroom, at the back of the site.
Guide: The dinosaur hall is right next to the maritime gallery, on its left side.
Guide: The learning studio is right next to the maritime gallery, on its right side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 2. The holiday village.
Guide: Welcome to the holiday village. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the nature trail office. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the restaurant is the first building on your right.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the boat house is the first building on your left.
Guide: The bike hire is directly behind the nature trail office, at the back of the site.
Guide: The campfire circle is directly behind the restaurant, at the back of the site.
Guide: The games room is right next to the bike hire, on its left side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 3. The sports centre.
Guide: Welcome to the sports centre. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the changing rooms. It is the first building on your left.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the reception is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the swimming pool is the first building on your right.
Guide: The juice bar is directly behind the reception, at the back of the site.
Guide: The dance studio is right next to the juice bar, on its right side.
Guide: The squash courts is directly behind the changing rooms, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 4. The university campus.
Guide: Welcome to the university campus. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the bike shed. It is the first building on your left.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the canteen. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the sports hall. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: The art studio is directly behind the canteen, at the back of the site.
Guide: The health centre is directly behind the bike shed, at the back of the site.
Guide: The library is directly behind the sports hall, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
